snippets.snippet_text: "Where Gumroad treats courses like glorified file downloads, Podia includes a proper course builder with drip content, quizzes, completion tracking, and a clean learning experience for your students. You also get a full website and blog builder on your own custom domain, so Podia can replace both your course host and your basic website. That's a level of integration Gumroad simply doesn't offer."
